To address the F5 E2 error code on your WFW5620HW0, you should check the following:

1. Ensure that the door is closing completely and that there are no items blocking it, as this can prevent the door from locking properly [2][6].
2. Verify that the door lock system is functioning correctly by referring to TEST #4: Door Lock System in the service manual [2][3][5].

If these checks do not resolve the issue, further diagnostics may be necessary.

To address the F3E2 error code on your WFW5620HW0, which indicates a Wash NTC Fault, you should check if the wash temperature sensor is out of range, or if there is an open circuit or short circuit detected. Refer to TEST #10: Wash Temperature Sensor on page 3-17 of the service manual W11169652 Rev B for detailed troubleshooting steps [1].
